meta.feature: Button Test page (按键测试) and the D2 test-mode command
meta.method: static analysis of Dart AOT blutter disassembly; addresses are code addresses in the libapp AOT snapshot of each build
meta.live_correction_2026_09_27: notification stream is EVENT-DRIVEN: the official app received 155 valid frames while a key was pressed and 0 while idle. Zero idle frames is NOT a failure and is not treated as one anywhere in this document.

states.name: APP_CONNECTED
states.description: GATT services discovered; write characteristic FFE1 and notify characteristic FFE2 resolved

states.name: NOTIFY_ARMED
states.description: notification stream live. 4.0.8 only: armed at connect time by the connection object; 2.22-2.24: armed later by the page

states.name: ROUTE_PUSHED
states.description: Button Test entry tapped; RainbowTest pushed as a MaterialPageRoute

states.name: WIDGET_INIT
states.description: _RainbowTestState constructed (mask table initialised); dependencies resolved (4.0.8 resolves Provider<BluetoothModel> into a state field)

states.name: INITSTATE_RAN
states.description: initState executed. 4.0.8 registers a post-frame callback and sends nothing; 2.22-2.24 call testModeSwitch() and subscribeCharacteristic() inline

states.name: D2_ENABLE_ISSUED
states.description: A5 05 D2 01 7D handed to the write path

states.name: WRITE_FFE1
states.description: frame written to the control characteristic

states.name: LISTENER_OWNED
states.description: page-level notification listener registered and its subscription object stored in a state field

states.name: PARSER_ACTIVE
states.description: inbound frame reaches the parser (analysisData or the listener closure)

states.name: FRAME_DROPPED
states.description: frame fails the version-specific gate and returns without touching UI state

states.name: FRAME_ACCEPTED
states.description: gate passed; 4-byte key mask decoded big-endian from frame[3..6]

states.name: UI_UPDATED
states.description: per-key booleans stored; setState issued only when parsed values differ from the previous snapshot

states.name: D2_DISABLE_ISSUED
states.description: A5 05 D2 00 7C handed to the write path, behind the version-specific dispose gate

states.name: DISPOSED
states.description: page gone; test mode requested off (no acknowledgement is awaited in any build)

version_specific_gates.gate: D2 enable deferred to a post-frame callback
version_specific_gates.evidence: 4.0.8 initState 0xacf744 contains no call to testModeSwitch (only a closure allocation); the enable sits in callback 0xacf874 at 0xacf8cc. 2.22 0x8e1eb0 / 2.23 0x8b0520 / 2.24 0x91cfb4 call it inline.
4.0.8 0xacfaac cmp #4 (Smi 2) after an indexed access with argument 4 (Smi 2) => frame[2]. The other builds gate on the 18-byte length instead.

version_specific_gates.gate: Notify subscription armed by the connection object at connect time
version_specific_gates.evidence: 4.0.8 BluetoothModel::onCharacteristicChanged 0xaca7c4 (setNotifyValue 0xaca818) runs from the GATT-ready continuation 0xaca690; the page only listens on the already-live stream (0xacf960/0xacf9a4).
2.22 0x95a8d0 / 2.23 0x881a40 / 2.24 0x9336e8 compare the state to an Obj!DeviceConnectionState instance. 4.0.8 instead checks a non-null field 0xadd838.
2.22 build 0x945854 Future::Future.delayed; 2.23 build 0x829638; 2.24 build 0x8c3bc0. 4.0.8 build 0x9f6264 contains no Future.delayed at all.

version_specific_gates.gate: write() precondition bit 0x1e on the init-state object
version_specific_gates.evidence: 4.0.8 0x80dd78 tst x1,#0x1e. The page-level writers of the other builds call their injected closure directly.

unknowns: 2.24 gate operand: cmp w0,#0x24 at 0x91d168. Read as Smi 18 with the same tagging convention that the dump uses for the D2 frame literals (0x14a = Smi 165), giving frame[1]==18. A raw reading (frame[2]==36) cannot be fully excluded from the bytes alone; the length-byte reading is graded STRONG EVIDENCE, not PROVEN.

The concrete 16-bit UUID bound to the page-level write closure in 2.22/2.23/2.24 could not be resolved statically (the characteristic objects are injected by the parent page). FFE1 write / FFE2 notify is STRONG EVIDENCE from define.dart and the 2.22 app logcat, not proven for the page closure.
Object identity of _RainbowTestState.field_b in 2.22/2.23/2.24 is INFERRED to be the _RainbowTest widget from its use sites; the field name is not recoverable from the AOT image.
